public partial record ItemDto
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Creates a new ItemDto from the specified Item entity.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="entity">The source entity to map from.</param>
    /// <returns>A new ItemDto instance.</returns>
    public static ItemDto FromEntity(global::TestApp.Item entity)
    {
        global::Pragmatic.Ensure.Ensure.ThrowIfNull(entity);
        
        ItemDto? customResult = null;
        BeforeMapping(entity, ref customResult);
        if (customResult is not null)
        {
            return customResult;
        }
        
        var ctx = new ItemDtoMappingContext
        {
            Id = entity.Id,
            Quantity = (entity.Quantity).GetValueOrDefault(),
        }
        ;
        
        CustomizeMapping(entity, ref ctx);
        
        return new ItemDto
        {
            Id = ctx.Id,
            Quantity = ctx.Quantity,
        }
        ;
    }

    }
